H01.description: Imports getTransitionRoot, needed by the fragment-transition removal fix.

H07.description: Removing a Fragment that carries a transition removes its DOM right away (or only handles the DEV root-fragment case), so the leave transition never runs and afterLeave is never called, which can leave out-in transitions stuck in production builds.

H08.description: performRemove only calls hostRemove on the single el, so it cannot remove a transitioning fragment's full range of nodes after leave.

H09.description: The leave-transition check tests the vnode's own ELEMENT shape flag, so it never matches a fragment whose transition root is an element.

H10.description: leave and delayLeave are given the vnode's el, which for a fragment is the start anchor rather than the transitioning root element.
